newsitem.title: UK: CE Electric buys 12.72 pct of Northern.
newsitem.headline: CE Electric buys 12.72 pct of Northern.

text.p: CalEnergy's CE Electric UK unit, which on Monday bid 651 million stg for British regional utility Northern Electric Plc, said it has bought some 12.9 million shares in Northern, amounting to 12.72 percent of the ordinary equity at 630p per share.
The disclosure was made to the London Stock Exchange by Hoare Govett Corporate Finance.
CE Electric UK is 70 percent owned by CalEnergy.
It is offering 630 pence per ordinary share and 103 pence per preference share, valuing the preference share capital at 115 million stg.

CE said the hostile bid came after it failed to agree a price with Northern which has advised shareholders to take no action pending a further announcement later on Monday. -- Lodon Newsroom +44 171 542 7717.
